key_findings: Spider peptide d/k-TRTX-Pm1a evokes nocifensive behaviour and hyperexcitability of small DRG neurons by enhancing Nav1.8 currents, inhibiting Kv2.1 and slowing inactivation of TTX-S Nav channels including Nav1.7.
The Nav1.8 inhibitor A803467 reversed sPm1a-induced firing and pain behaviours.
